description:
This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

In 1990 Washington, a man planned to rob H&J Leather & Firearms, a gun store that was packed during normal business hours. He fired a 38-caliber pistol to intimidate people, but the rounds went wide, and the police officer inside returned fire. Several customers drew weapons too, but it was already clear the robbery was going nowhere. What other crime “fail fast” moments should we cover next?
